contact_model.geometry: one pre-spawned static triangle mesh with alternating coplanar face-material subsets and MeshCollisionAPI approximation none

fall_detection.combined_rule: contact termination OR base height below threshold OR body up-axis z below threshold

failed_evaluations.failure_classification: reproducible Isaac Sim native process termination; policy performance unresolved

interpretation_contract.contiguous_pass_floor: lowest coefficient reached before the first all-direction failure
interpretation_contract.baseline_qualification: a mixed-friction tolerance is withheld when the uniform nominal case fails the same gate
interpretation_contract.lowest_tested_passing: lowest isolated passing case, reported separately when results are non-monotonic
interpretation_contract.non_monotonic_warning: a later isolated pass does not erase an earlier failure
interpretation_contract.failed_evaluation: a simulator-native termination is unresolved evidence and is excluded from policy pass/fail thresholds
interpretation_contract.claim_scope: single-seed Isaac Sim stress test, not a real-floor friction guarantee
